verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's `npm create cloudflare@latest` CLI (C3) offers scaffolding for common frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro) and use cases like MCP servers, functioning as starter templates, but evidence doesn't show a true 'one-click' deploy-from-template gallery like Vercel/Netlify, and community feedback notes CF lags in developer-platform polish/mindshare.
